text: Lena, a biology professor and former soldier, finds her husband Kane at home a year after he vanished into the Shimmer, and he is soon gravely ill. To learn why, she joins four women scientists crossing into [a glimmering zone that keeps spreading|wants|spreading and taking over] from a Florida lighthouse where a meteor fell. Inside, time slips, radios die, [plants grow into human shapes|images|plants, trees and fungus] and [a mutant bear cries out in a dead woman's voice|threat|nature turning on us]. At the lighthouse waits [something that learns to wear Lena's body|threat|impostors and doubles].
